workers.success: Phase handoff success, reported separately from full pickup
workers.phase_reward: Negative additive state costs plus one-time phase bonus and worst-cost absorbing failure tail
workers.privileged_handoff_metrics: Reward/evaluation only; no actor inputs or control overrides
workers.arrival_velocity_method: Reset-only Jacobian inversion; no controller after reset
workers.default_reset_height_reference: Cup-relative Z; inherited height_bands are used only with explicit override
workers.reset_height_info: Actual hand world Z minus .310 m; may be negative for centered bootstrap starts
workers.centered_bilateral_quality: min(minimum contact force/0.5 N,1) * exp(-hypot(XY distance outside15 mm band/15 mm, Z distance outside0–15 mm band/15 mm))
workers.centered_full_pickup_metric: Existing centered benchmark: XY<=15 mm, relative Z0–15 mm, downward tilt<=15 degrees, original bilateral contact, clearance>=60 mm, upright<=20 degrees, cup speed<0.1 m/s for25 consecutive actions
workers.centered_full_pickup_contact_force: Original contact threshold only; phase minimum0.5 N is not added to this metric
